name: Decline Dumbbell Skullcrusher
description: A decline bench variation of the skullcrusher performed with dumbbells. The decline angle shifts emphasis to the long head of the triceps and reduces elbow stress. Using dumbbells allows independent arm movement and a natural rotation of the wrists.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Decline Dumbbell Skullcrusher in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Decline Dumbbell Skullcrusher.
steps: Step 1: Set bench to decline. Lie with head lower, hold dumbbells at arm's length.
Step 2: Bend elbows to lower dumbbells toward temples, keeping upper arms fixed.
Step 3: Lower until forearms are past parallel to floor.
Step 4: Press back to full extension.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Keep upper arms perpendicular to floor
